Title: Verify that newly created measuring parameters include a unique 4-character alphanumeric ID (nsId) in the response
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with permissions to create items and measuring parameters
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create Item' page. 2. Enter item details (e.g., name: 'Shirt', status: 'ACTIVE'). 3. Add a new measuring parameter with the following details: Name (English): 'Collar Size', Unit: 'inch', Type: 'NUMERIC', Suggestive Values: ['14', '15', '16']. 4. Click 'Save' to create the item. 5. Navigate to the item details page and expand the measuring parameters section.

Test Data: Item: Name (English) = 'Shirt', Name (Bangla) = 'শার্ট', Status = 'ACTIVE'; Measuring Parameter: Name (English) = 'Collar Size', Unit = 'inch', Type = 'NUMERIC', Suggestive Values = ['14', '15', '16']
Expected Result: 1. The item is created successfully with a confirmation message: 'Item created successfully'. 2. The measuring parameter 'Collar Size' is displayed with its details, including a unique 4-character alphanumeric ID (e.g., 'A1B2') under the 'ID' column.

Title: Verify that text-type measuring parameters are saved, displayed, and returned correctly in order measurements
Preconditions: User is logged in as a shop owner with an existing order for a customer and an item with text-type measuring parameters
Steps:
1. Navigate to the 'Create Order' page. 2. Select an existing customer (e.g., 'John Doe'). 3. Select an item (e.g., 'Shirt') that has a text-type measuring parameter (e.g., 'Special Notes'). 4. Enter a value for the text-type measuring parameter (e.g., 'Extra stitching on collar'). 5. Complete the order creation process. 6. Navigate to the order details page and expand the measurement section. 7. Navigate to the 'Measurement History' tab for the customer.

Test Data: Customer: Name = 'John Doe', Phone = '01712345678'; Item: Name = 'Shirt'; Measuring Parameter: Name = 'Special Notes', Type = 'TEXT', Value = 'Extra stitching on collar'
Expected Result: 1. The order is created successfully with a confirmation message: 'Order created successfully'. 2. The order details page displays the text measurement parameter: 'Special Notes = Extra stitching on collar' with its unique 4-character alphanumeric ID. 3. The 'Measurement History' tab for the customer displays the same text measurement parameter with its unique ID.
